Wordle — rules
Goal
Guess the hidden Russian noun consisting of exactly five letters. Enter a word and submit it to receive color clues. Victory is recorded only when all five letters match the answer.
Color clues

Green means the letter is correct and in the correct position. Yellow means the answer contains that letter in another position. Gray means the answer has no remaining occurrence of that letter. Repeated letters are checked against their actual count in the answer.
Accepted words
Only complete five-letter words from the Russian dictionary are accepted. An incomplete or unknown word does not consume an attempt. The letters Е and Ё are treated as Е.
Difficulty
Easy allows 8 attempts, Normal allows 6, and Hard allows 4. Changing difficulty discards only the active Wordle game and creates a new hidden word.
Controls

Use the on-screen Russian keyboard or the corresponding physical key positions. Enter submits the current word. Backspace or Delete removes the last letter. After victory or defeat input is locked; New Game creates a fresh attempt.
F5/F9 and menu loading preserve the hidden word, all rows, the keyboard colors and the reward fixed when the attempt started. Easy gives no reward. Defeat is not recorded and gives no reward.
